description: It's no secret that law enforcement is a reflection of the guy at the top, the Governor. The Governor reigns supreme over every facet of the executive branch, and the sheriff's of this state simply follow the leader. The problem is that they have followed Ron DeSantis straight into the depths of tyranny. Moe first…
title: Florida’s Bad Cop Problem: Why Moe Will Suspend T.K. Waters from Office – No MOE Corruption
